Michigan Compiled Laws, current through 2026 Michigan Public Acts

750.321 Manslaughter.

Any person who shall commit the crime of manslaughter shall be guilty of a felony.

Michigan Compiled Laws, current through 2026 Michigan Public Acts

750.552 Willful trespass.

A person who willfully enters the lands or premises of another without permission is guilty of trespass.
